role_sought: President of the Republic (with Iliana Iotova for Vice President)
result: First place, qualified for the run-off
detail: Nominated by an initiative committee represented by Stefan Danailov, with the backing of the Bulgarian Socialist Party. Official results of the Central Election Commission.
Official results of the Central Election Commission. Took office on 22 January 2017.

role_sought: President of the Republic (re-election, with Iliana Iotova)
result: First place, qualified for the run-off
opponent: Anastas Gerdzhikov (initiative committee for Anastas Gerdzhikov and Nevyana Miteva), 610,862 votes (22.83%)
detail: Nominated by an initiative committee for Rumen Radev and Iliana Iotova. Official results of the Central Election Commission.
Official results of the Central Election Commission.

role_sought: Member of the National Assembly, head of the Progressive Bulgaria lists in the 2nd constituency (Burgas) and the 25th constituency (Sofia); candidate for Prime Minister
result: Progressive Bulgaria first with an outright majority (131 of 240 seats)
detail: Official Central Election Commission results. In Burgas, Progressive Bulgaria won 82,689 votes (47.422%) and 8 seats, with 22,741 preference votes for Radev; in Sofia's 25th constituency, 76,252 votes (41.976%) and 7 seats, with 21,541 preference votes for him.

election: Election of the Prime Minister by the National Assembly
detail: The cabinet as a whole was voted in with 122 votes (Novinite); Progressive Bulgaria held 131 of the 240 seats.
